selection: validation only: smallest worst city/case mean delay ratio against max-pressure, then average delay ratio; no city-specific routing rule
scope: Exploratory real OSM networks with assumed demand and signal plans. No municipal field savings or independently validated twin claim.
shift: within-minute departure compression into first 10 seconds; same scheduled routes, no future schedule provided to policy
learned_baseline: Frozen ATLAS 4 four-source-city cooperative Q rotation, inference only; original training and regressions preserved
surrogate: Retired from candidate selection: ATLAS 4 queue predictor lost to persistence in all cities and has no counterfactual ranking evidence
